name: record_practice_attempt
description: Check and save the student's answer to a practice question. Pass their words verbatim. Returns verdict, feedback, possible misconceptions with evidence quoted from their answer, review step and model answer. Misconceptions are recorded only when the answer matches the student's saved words.
